summary: iter-421 UI-only refinements (Chunk D, Asks 1-5) VERIFIED on Zygoma+Pterygoid+Conventional workflow. Test case: 6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69 ('Test Patient Zygoma') seeded via Mongo to represent a mixed Zygoma+Pterygoid+Conventional case with 5 implant_plans [zygoma ZR1, zygoma ZL1, pterygoid PR1, conventional 14, conventional 24], phase2_data.prosthetic_components=[Immediate, Immediate, Immediate, Cover Screw Placed, Healing Abutment Placed], phase2_data.prosthesis_type='Fixed', prosthetic_plan='Fixed hybrid', status='phase2_approved'. Login as Abhijit.patil / Admin@123. ASK 1 PASS — On submit-stage2-surgical/[id] (Phase 3), submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id] (Phase 4 Step 1), submit-phase4-step2/[id] (Phase 4 Step 2) and followup/[id] (Phase 5), `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid*="tabbed"]')` returns 0 elements — the Zygoma/Pterygoid/Conventional PhaseTabbedAutoFetch sub-view has been removed. Rest of each form renders normally (Phase 4 Step 1 Final Prosthesis Selection dropdown, Phase 4 Step 2 per-implant IOPA grid with 5 tooth rows ZR1/ZL1/PR1/14/24, Phase 5 systemic + comfort/pain/chewing checklist). Confirmed via code inspection: imports comment `// iter-Jun-2026 (v13, Chunk D, Ask 1): PhaseTabbedAutoFetch removed from Phase 3/4Step1/4Step2/5.` present in all four files. ASK 2 PASS — Visible on Case Details Phase 2 review (`phase2-per-implant-readback`): ZR1 & ZL1 (zygoma) render orange (#F57C00) borders, PR1 (pterygoid) renders blue (#1565C0), 14 & 24 (conventional) render yellow (#F9A825). Chip colours (Cover Screw purple / Healing Abutment teal / Immediate Loading orange) unchanged. Code: [id].tsx L3065-3072 `_outlineFor` returns {border, width:2} for each of the three types + grey fallback for unknown, applied at L3115-3120 on `phase2-implant-card-{idx}`. ASK 3 PASS — Global `phase2-prosthesis-type-summary` row renders above the per-implant chips showing 'Prosthesis Type: Fixed' when `phase2_data.prosthesis_type` is set and at least one implant is Immediate Loading Done (verified via UI screenshot). Each Immediate Loading card still shows the inline 'Prosthesis type: Fixed' line. Code L3088-3106 gates rendering on `_hasAnyImmediateLoading`; fallback text is '— (not recorded)' when prosthesis_type is empty. Legacy stray 'Prosthesis Type — Tap to add' row is correctly suppressed via L3193/3203 guard `!Array.isArray(procedure.phase2_data.prosthetic_components)` — only fires when phase2 uses the legacy single-implant flow. ASK 4 PASS (form-side visually confirmed) — On submit-stage2-surgical/[id], the `phase3-immediate-prosthesis-banner` banner now renders 3 lines: 'Immediate Prosthesis Done' / 'Prosthesis Type: Fixed' / 'Prosthetic Plan: Fixed hybrid' (via testID `phase3-banner-prosthetic-plan`, computed textContent: 'Prosthetic Plan: Fixed hybrid'). Case-details review-side `phase3-immediate-prosthesis-summary` block (L3522-3549) code inspection confirms both Prosthesis Type + Prosthetic Plan rendering keyed on `anyImmediate` check (per-implant array `.includes('Immediate Loading Done')` OR singular `.prosthetic_component`). Fallback '— (not recorded)' when prosthesis_type missing. This element only renders inside the Phase 3 review section which requires phase3_data to be present — for the test case (phase2_approved, no phase3_data yet) this block does not appear yet, but the code path is correct. ASK 5 PASS — In the Phase 3 form's Healing Abutment Configuration section, only 2 cards render: Implant 4 (Phase 2: Cover Screw Placed) and Implant 5 (Phase 2: Healing Abutment Placed · 4 mm) — the 3 Immediate Loading implants ZR1/ZL1/PR1 are correctly omitted (submit-stage2-surgical/[id].tsx L523 early return on `phase2_component === 'Immediate Loading Done'`). L508 gates the whole section behind `haConfig.some(c => c.phase2_component !== 'Immediate Loading Done')` so a fully-Immediate case would hide the section entirely (no empty header). Validation (L290) also skips Immediate implants when computing `haMissingIdxs` — so the 'Healing Abutment Configuration (N implants incomplete)' alert only counts non-Immediate implants. Review-side (`phase3-per-implant-ha` at L3636-3639) mirrors the same skip. Screenshots captured: /tmp/iter421_p3_form_top.png (Ask 1+4), /tmp/iter421_p3_ha.png (Ask 5 form), /tmp/iter421_phase2_after_click.png (Ask 2+3 review), /tmp/iter421_submit-stage2-prosthetic.png + /tmp/iter421_submit-phase4-step2.png + /tmp/iter421_followup.png (Ask 1 for other phases).
critical_code_review_comments: submit-stage2-surgical/[id].tsx L14, submit-phase4-step2/[id].tsx L11, submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx L15, followup/[id].tsx L18 — each file carries a matching 'iter-Jun-2026 (v13, Chunk D, Ask 1): PhaseTabbedAutoFetch removed from Phase N.' comment where the import used to be. Import is fully gone, not just commented out — good cleanup.

[id].tsx L3065-3072 `_outlineFor` uses a lower-cased `implant_type` compare and falls back to grey (#E0E0E0 width:1) so unknown / missing types still render. The 3 known types (zygoma/pterygoid/conventional) use width:2 for visual emphasis. Border-color-only change keeps chip colours (per-status) untouched — consistent with the spec.
[id].tsx L3088 gate `_hasAnyImmediateLoading` handles both the per-implant array AND the legacy singular field so the summary row shows on legacy Zygoma cases too. Good.

[id].tsx L3193 / L3203 — the legacy 'Tap to add' rows for prosthesis_type / cuff_height_mm are correctly wrapped in `!Array.isArray(procedure.phase2_data.prosthetic_components)`, preventing the double-rendering the Ask 3 spec called out. Single-implant legacy flow (array null) still gets the placeholders.

submit-stage2-surgical/[id].tsx L508 (section gate) + L523 (per-card skip) + L290 (validation skip) are the three points that make Ask 5 water-tight — all three consistently key on `phase2_component === 'Immediate Loading Done'`. Ordering is correct: validation runs before submit, and if all implants are Immediate the whole HA section header is hidden (no orphan 'Healing Abutment Configuration *' header without cards).
[id].tsx L3639 mirrors the same Ask-5 skip on the case-details review side (`phase3-per-implant-ha`). Consistent with the form.

submit-stage2-surgical/[id].tsx L421-426 correctly gates the Prosthetic Plan sub-row on `prostheticPlan` being truthy — so cases without a plan don't get a stray empty 'Prosthetic Plan:' label. The 'Other' → prostheticPlanOther fall-through is preserved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 asks verified; 4/4 phase forms render without tabbed views; all 5 testIDs of interest — phase2-per-implant-readback, phase2-prosthesis-type-summary, phase2-implant-card-{0..4}, phase3-immediate-prosthesis-banner, phase3-banner-prosthetic-plan — render with correct content and colours)
